title: Guaranteed Energy Savings Performance Contract
short_description: RFQ for design and implementation of energy savings upgrades in county facilities.
project_scope: Design and implementation of a Guaranteed Energy Savings Performance Contract across various Charlton County facilities. The notice does not specify building types, number of facilities, gross floor areas, or technical measures.
services: Design-build/developer services and energy engineering for a guaranteed energy savings performance contract.
relevance_explanation:
- General building energy performance contract, not a structural or bridge project.
- Focus appears to be ESCO-led energy upgrades rather than structural design.
- No indication of long-span structures, special structures, bridges, sports venues, or complex building structures.
- Tender aligns more with energy services/MEP-oriented scope, which is generally not relevant for sbp.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the notice. Available information for any estimate is very limited: county-wide facilities in Charlton County, Georgia, under a guaranteed energy savings performance contract, but no facility count, sizes, baseline energy use, or measure package are provided.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated in the notice. Because the scope is an ESCO performance contract without defined structural planning services, a realistic sbp fee estimate is not possible from the available information.
references_qualifications: Interested Energy Services Companies (ESCOs); disciplines requested are design-build/developer and energy engineering. No specific reference counts or qualification thresholds are stated in the notice excerpt.
